title: Dr. SoW: Density Ratio of Strong-over-weak LLMs for Reducing the Cost of Human Annotation in Preference Tuning
reasoning: The paper introduces a reward modeling method called Dr.SoW. While it includes a 'Safety' evaluation domain which covers 'unethical behavior', this is treated as a standard safety/compliance category for LLM alignment rather than a specific evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
